title: Deep Learning Fundamentals: Training Neural Networks Step-by-Step

cues.en: -: Hello, and welcome back to the course on Deep Learning.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回到深度學習課程。

cues.en: Today, we're going to wrap up with back propagation.
cues.zh: 今天要用反向傳播作為總結。

cues.en: All right, so we already know pretty much everything we need to know about what happens in the neural network.
cues.zh: 我們已經大致了解神經網路中需要知道的各種運作。

cues.en: We know that there's a process called forward propagation, where information is entered into the input layer and then is propagated forward, to get our Y Hats, our output values,
cues.zh: 其中一個過程叫前向傳播：資訊從輸入層進入，再向前傳遞，最後得到預測值 ŷ，也就是輸出值。

cues.en: and then we compare those to the actual values that we have in our training set, and then we calculate the errors.
cues.zh: 接著把預測值與訓練集中實際的值比較，計算誤差。

cues.en: Then the errors are back propagated through the network in the opposite direction.
cues.zh: 然後讓誤差沿著相反方向，在網路中反向傳播。

cues.en: And that allows us to train the network by adjusting the weight.
cues.zh: 如此就能透過調整權重來訓練網路。

cues.en: So the one key important thing to remember here is that back propagation is an advanced algorithm driven by
cues.zh: 這裡有一個重要觀念要記住：反向傳播是一種先進演算法，背後運用

cues.en: very interesting and sophisticated mathematics, which allows us to adjust the weights, all of them at the same time.
cues.zh: 非常有意思而且精密的數學，讓我們可以同時調整所有權重。

cues.en: All of the weights are adjusted simultaneously.
cues.zh: 所有權重都能同時更新。

cues.en: So if we were doing this manually, or if we were coming up with a different type of algorithm, then even if we calculated the error and then we were trying to understand what effect
cues.zh: 如果手動處理，或自行設計另一種演算法，即使已經算出誤差，接著要了解

cues.en: each of the weights has on the error, we'd have to somehow adjust each of the weights independently or individually.
cues.zh: 各個權重對誤差的影響，也得想辦法獨立、逐一調整每個權重。

cues.en: The huge advantage of back propagation, and this is a key thing to remember, is that during the process of back propagation, simply because of the way
cues.zh: 反向傳播的一大優勢，也是必須記住的重點，在於執行反向傳播時，光是透過

cues.en: the algorithm is structured, you are able to adjust all of the weights at the same time, so you basically know which part of the error
cues.zh: 演算法本身的結構，就能同時調整所有權重。基本上，你能知道誤差中的哪一部分，

cues.en: each of your weights in the neural network is responsible for.
cues.zh: 是由神經網路裡的每個權重所造成。

cues.en: Now, that is the key fundamental, underlying, principle of back propagation, and this was why it picked up so rapidly
cues.zh: 這就是反向傳播背後最核心的基本原理，也是它在

cues.en: in the 1980s, and this was a major breakthrough.
cues.zh: 1980 年代迅速受到重視、成為重大突破的原因。

cues.en: And if you'd like to learn more about that and how exactly the mathematics works in the background, then a good article, which we've already mentioned, is the, "Neural Networks and Deep Learning."
cues.zh: 如果想更深入了解背後的數學，可以參考之前提過的《Neural Networks and Deep Learning》。

cues.en: It's actually a book by Michael Nielsen, that you'll find the mathematics written out, and it'll help you understand how exactly this is possible.
cues.zh: 那其實是 Michael Nielsen 寫的一本書，裡面列出數學推導，能幫你了解這件事如何做到。

cues.en: But for now, for our purposes, if from an intuition point of view, the important part is to remember that that's what back propagation does,
cues.zh: 不過目前就我們的用途而言，從直覺角度，只要記住反向傳播的作用，

cues.en: it adjusts all of the weights at the same time.
cues.zh: 就是同時調整所有權重。

cues.en: And now we're going to just wrap everything up with a step by step walkthrough of what happens in the training of a neural network.
cues.zh: 現在以逐步流程總結，看看神經網路訓練時會發生哪些事情。

cues.en: All right, so step one, we randomly initialized the weights to small numbers close to zero, but not zero.
cues.zh: 第一步，將權重隨機初始化為接近零、但不是零的小數值。

cues.en: We didn't really focus on the initialization of weights during the initiation tutorials, but the weights have to start somewhere, and they are initialized with random values near zero,
cues.zh: 先前的直覺教學沒有特別著重初始化，但權重總得有起始值，所以會使用接近零的隨機值，

cues.en: and then, from there, through the process of forward propagation, back propagation, these weights are adjusted, until the error is minimized.
cues.zh: 再透過前向傳播與反向傳播，不斷調整權重，直到誤差降到最小。

cues.en: Until the cost function is minimized.
cues.zh: 也就是將成本函數最小化。

cues.en: Then, step two, input the first observation of your data sets to the first row, into the input layer, each feature is one input node.
cues.zh: 第二步，將資料集第一筆觀測值，也就是第一列，輸入到輸入層，每個特徵對應一個輸入節點。

cues.en: So basically take the columns and put them into the input nodes.
cues.zh: 基本上就是取出各個欄位，放進對應的輸入節點。

cues.en: Step three, forward propagation, from left to right the neurons are activated in a way that the impact of each neurons' activation is limited by the weights, so the weights basically determine
cues.zh: 第三步，從左到右做前向傳播。神經元會被激活，而各神經元激活的影響程度受權重限制，所以權重會決定

cues.en: how important each neurons' activation is, then propagate the activations until getting the predicted result, Y Hat, in this case.
cues.zh: 各個神經元激活的重要性。繼續向前傳遞激活值，直到得到預測結果，在這裡就是 ŷ。

cues.en: So basically, you propagate from left to right.
cues.zh: 基本上就是從左往右傳播。

cues.en: You go all the way until you get to the end and you get your Y Hat.
cues.zh: 一路傳到最後，取得 ŷ。

cues.en: Then compare the predicted result to the actual result, measure the generated error.
cues.zh: 接著將預測結果與實際結果比較，量測產生的誤差。

cues.en: Then you do the back propagation from right to left, the error is back propagated, update the weights according to how much they are responsible for the error.
cues.zh: 然後從右往左進行反向傳播，依各權重對誤差的貢獻程度更新權重。

cues.en: Again, you're able to calculate that because of the way the back propagation algorithm is structured.
cues.zh: 同樣地，正是因為反向傳播演算法的結構，才能算出這些貢獻。

cues.en: The learning rate decides by how much we update.
cues.zh: 學習率則決定每次更新的幅度。

cues.en: The weights learning rate is parameter you can control in your neural network.
cues.zh: 學習率是你可以在神經網路中控制的參數。

cues.en: Step six, repeats steps one to five, and update the weights after each observation.
cues.zh: 第六步，重複第一到第五步，在每筆觀測值之後更新權重。

cues.en: That is called the reinforcement learning, and in our case, that was stochastic gradient descent, or repeat steps one to five, but update weights only after a batch of observations,
cues.zh: 這裡稱為強化學習；在我們的情況是隨機梯度下降。或者同樣重複第一到第五步，但只在處理一批觀測值之後更新權重，

cues.en: so batch learning, it's either a full gradient descent, or batch gradient descent, or mini batch gradient descent.
cues.zh: 也就是批次學習，可以是完整梯度下降、批次梯度下降，或小批次梯度下降。

cues.en: And step seven, when the whole trains had passed through their artificial neural network, that makes an epoch, redo more epochs, So basically just keep doing that, and doing that,
cues.zh: 第七步，整個訓練集通過人工神經網路一次，就是一個 epoch。接著再進行更多 epoch，不斷重複，

cues.en: and doing that, allowing your neural network to train better and better and better, and constantly adjust itself,
cues.zh: 讓神經網路訓練得越來越好，持續調整自己，

cues.en: as you minimize the cost function.
cues.zh: 並將成本函數最小化。

cues.en: So, there we go, those are the steps you need to take to build your artificial neural networks and train it.
cues.zh: 以上就是建立與訓練人工神經網路所需的步驟。

cues.en: And these are the steps that you will be taking together (indistinct) in the practical tutorials.
cues.zh: 實作教學時，你也會一起進行這些步驟。

cues.en: Wish you the best of luck, and I look forward to seeing you next time.
cues.zh: 祝你學習順利，期待下次再見。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy Deep Learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受深度學習吧。
